name: rai
description: Set up research projects, audit inputs, sync Git and Overleaf, and manage references in Zotero.

interface.longDescription: Rai uses the host's tools to review a local research project, find missing inputs, and propose changes. With access to the relevant service, it can verify shared data, review Git and Overleaf synchronization, and work with Zotero.
defaultPrompt: Use Rai to review this folder and tell me how to start or resume work.
Check whether my inputs will work from a fresh checkout.
Review these PDFs for import to Zotero and check attachment sync.
